about: Hold Fart is a photo of a teenage student in a black hoodie sitting at a classroom desk, red-faced, staring ahead with a visible vein on his forehead and his lips pressed together, plainly holding something in with all his strength. A classmate beside him looks away, unaware. The image became a reaction for any moment of desperate self-control: holding in a laugh, a sneeze, an opinion or exactly what the original title says. The comedy is in the strain on his face and the calm of everyone around him.
origin: The photo was posted to Reddit's /r/funny in 2014, titled as a classmate struggling not to pass gas beside a girl he liked, and it quickly became a reaction image for straining to stay quiet.
usage:
The top box describes the situation that demands silence: a quiet exam room, a serious meeting, a funeral-level awkward moment. The bottom box names what you are holding in, or how long you have been holding it.

The strongest captions are about holding back something verbal or emotional: a laugh at the wrong time, a spoiler, a correction to your teacher, a hot take in the group chat. The higher the stakes of staying silent, the better the vein reads.
ideas: when the whole class goes quiet
and you've been holding it for an hour
when someone mispronounces your favorite anime
trying not to spoil the finale
when the teacher makes a typo
when someone says "I don't really play video games"
and you have 4,000 hours in one
aka: Trying to Hold a Fart Next to a Cute Girl in Class
